extensions.name: mcp-server
extensions.description: Serve Amira over MCP (stdio) so other coding agents can delegate tasks to it: amira mcp serve

extensions.name: workflow
extensions.description: Dynamic workflows: TypeScript scripts that orchestrate many sub-agents in the background, with limits, a progress view and resume

extensions.name: swarm
extensions.description: Swarm mode: long-lived sub-agents that work on one goal together through a shared blackboard and direct messages: /swarm <goal>

extensions.name: lsp
extensions.description: Language server diagnostics after edits: errors in the files the model changed go back to it with the tool result; also a diagnostics tool and /lsp

extensions.name: notify
extensions.description: Notifications when Amira needs you: a long turn ended, a question waits, background agents finished; Windows/macOS/Linux desktop, Telegram, Discord, WeCom or any JSON webhook

extensions.name: todo
extensions.description: A todo list the model keeps for multi-step work (todo_write, todo_read), shown live above the activity line and kept with the session

extensions.name: share
extensions.description: Export sessions as Markdown or self-contained HTML (secrets redacted), and git helpers: /commit messages, /pr drafts (opened with gh) and /review by a reviewer sub-agent

extensions.name: hooks
extensions.description: Hooks: your commands on events, e.g. a formatter after each edit, a guard that blocks or asks before risky shell commands, tests after a turn

extensions.name: browser
extensions.description: Browser tools: the model opens pages (e.g. your dev server) in an installed Chrome or Edge, headless, and takes screenshots, clicks, types, evaluates and reads the console; offers other extensions HTML rendered to a PNG (browser.renderHtmlToPng)

extensions.name: checkpoints
extensions.description: Checkpoints and /rewind: a snapshot of the files before each turn, in private git refs, and a way back to any of them (files, or files and conversation)

extensions.name: images
extensions.description: Images in replies drawn in the terminal (Sixel, kitty, iTerm2): local files and http(s) URLs with web_fetch's private-network protection, decoded and encoded off the main thread

extensions.name: mermaid
extensions.description: ```mermaid blocks as diagrams: flowcharts and sequence diagrams as Unicode text that fits the width, other types as pictures with the images and browser extensions
